priorityList: Maintain Blade Flurry and use it at low Combo Points due to Deft Maneuvers
Use Keep It Rolling when you have 4+ buffs already
Use Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at low Combo Points
Use Blade Rush on cooldown as if it were a regular builder
Use Between on cooldown with 6+ Combo Points
Use Killing Spree on cooldown at 6+ Combo Points
Cast Dispatch as your main finisher with 6+ Combo Points
Cast Pistol Shot if you have 6 stacks; if you have 3 stacks, use it at 1-3 Combo Points only
Cast Sinister Strike to Build Combo Points
